rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone is focused on listening, watching, or doing something.

example.english: You need to be attentive and listen carefully in class.
example.jyutping: soeng6 tong4 go2 zan6 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 teng1 syu1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is deliberately alert and noticing what is happening.

example.english: Be attentive when crossing the road, and don't look at your phone.
example.traditional: 你過馬路嗰陣要留心吓，唔好睇電話。
example.jyutping: nei5 gwo3 maa5 lou6 go2 zan6 jiu3 lau4 sam1 haa5 m4 hou2 tai2 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this when attentiveness shows itself as careful attention to details or to other people.

example.english: They are very attentive in their work and even spot small mistakes.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好細心，連啲小錯都搵到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1 lin4 di1 siu2 co3 dou1 wan2 dou2
